trigger_patterns: issuing any occupational, professional, or business license pursuant to Titles?\b
proposal.rationale: Refined to capture AR Title 17 Chapter 1 (Professions Generally) sections that impose cross-cutting requirements on all occupational licensing entities. Chapter 1 functions as the umbrella chapter — sections 17-1-103, 17-1-105, 17-1-107, 17-1-108, 17-1-110 all begin with "An occupational licensing entity shall..." which signals universal applicability across all professions licensed under Title 17. Section 17-1-104 explicitly enumerates Titles 2-6, 8, 9, 14, 15, 17, 20, 22, 23, 27 — but for our purposes the trigger pattern catches the enumeration. Section 17-1-105 uses "Each board, commission, or other entity that licenses..." Section 17-1-109 (Workforce Freedom Act) restricts political subdivisions from regulating any profession or occupation. Section 17-1-102 covers committee members of professional societies generally. I left 17-1-106 (repealed) and 17-2-101 (just a short title with no scoping language) unmatched — those are genuinely undetermined from anchor text alone.
